Class PDFComment

java.lang.Object
com.cloudofficeprint.RenderElements.PDF.PDFInsertObject
com.cloudofficeprint.RenderElements.PDF.PDFComment
public class PDFComment extends PDFInsertObject
Represents a comment to be inserted into a PDF file. Supports customization options like font style, size, and color.

  • Constructor Details

    • PDFComment

      public PDFComment(Integer x, Integer y, Integer pageNumber, String comment)
      Constructs a new PDFComment object.
      Parameters:
      x - X-coordinate of the position of the comment in the template, starting from the bottom left.
      y - Y-coordinate of the position of the comment in the template, starting from the bottom left.
      pageNumber - Page number where the comment should be inserted. Use -1 to display on all pages.
      comment - The comment text to insert.
